Definition: Shimon, one of Jacob's sons, also the tribe descended from him
BiblicalUsage: Simeon or Shimeon = "heard"; 1) the 2nd son of Jacob by his wife Leah and progenitor of the tribe of Simeon; 2) an Israelite of the sons of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
